//: Capability manifest for <Select> (the .pa-select control) — svelte-pure-admin. Select.svelte renders <select class="pa-select {size} {state} {color} {class}" ...>{@render children}</select>, with a `multiple` branch. Size + state + themeColor are the class axes; isDisabled/isRequired/isMultiple emit the native attributes; name/id native. The option `children` snippet is OUT OF SCOPE (API-divergent from keen's options list) — not mapped, so every scenario renders the empty select.
